item.title: Avanti West Coast trialling world first optimisation technology
item.description: Avanti West Coast has begun trialling a pioneering timetable-optimisation tool, believed to be a world first for the transport industry, aiming to improve reliability during unplanned disruption.

item.title: Carlisle station welcomes new pub
item.description: A new heritage pub has steamed into life at Carlisle railway station, promising to galvanise Cumbria’s independent brewery scene. The Scott & Brassey officially opened on 25 February on Platform 4, with the first pint pulled in a venue transformed from a former First Class waiting room into a characterful celebration of railway history.

item.title: Frame assembly complete on George the Fifth steam locomotive
item.description: The LNWR George the Fifth Steam Locomotive Trust has announced that on Wednesday 4 and Thursday 5 February, it finished assembling the permanent frame for its replica locomotive.

item.title: Alstom trains and signalling enter service in India
item.description: Alstom has brought into operational service trains and ETCS signalling on the Namo Bharat corridor and the Meerut Metro near Delhi in India.

item.title: Cardiff Arms Park Male Voice Choir brings song to Paddington as part of Wales Week
item.description: Great Western Railway marked Wales Week London in unforgettable style as the Cardiff Arms Park Male Voice Choir turned London Paddington into a stirring celebration of song.

item.title: Derbyshire heritage railway issues loco update
item.description: Derbyshire's Midland Railway – Butterley has issued an update on work on two of its locomotives.

item.title: New kiosk welcoming ScotRail customers to Airdrie station
item.description: Customers travelling with ScotRail at Airdrie railway station can now enjoy a freshly brewed coffee and a hot breakfast roll ahead of their journey, following the arrival of Rosco's Rolls kiosk.

item.title: Talyllyn Railway’s steam loco No. 6 Douglas now available in 009 scale
item.description: Model Railway manufacturer Fourdees has released two 009 scale model kits of Talyllyn Railway No. 6 Douglas exclusively for the Talyllyn Railway.

item.title: Acquisition establishes Canadian terminal operator as North America’s market leader
item.description: Cando Rail & Terminals of Canada has acquired Savage Rail of the USA, making it a market leader in first- and last-mile rail operating services.
